title: Hallucination-R1: Robustness-Oriented Paraphrase Generation for Factual Consistency
abstract: arXiv:2609.21227v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Factual hallucination is commonly defined by incorrect factual outputs. We study a paraphrase-induced hallucination setting, where a model answers a factual question correctly in its original form but generates an incorrect answer under a semantically equivalent paraphrase. Such inconsistencies expose latent factual instability under semantic invariance. However, general-purpose paraphrases are often insufficient as robustness-oriented supervision: near-copy paraphrases provide weak signals, while overly diverse paraphrases may break semantic equivalence. In this paper, we propose HALLUCINATION-R1, a robustness-oriented paraphrase generation framework that learns to produce semantically faithful yet robustness-challenging paraphrases for factual consistency. Through two-stage optimization, it first stabilizes meaning-preserving and diverse paraphrasing, then rewards paraphrases that reveal factual consistency degradation in downstream

translated_title: 幻觉-R1：面向鲁棒性的释义生成以保障事实一致性
translated_abstract: 事实性幻觉通常被定义为错误的事实输出。我们研究了一种由释义引发的幻觉场景：模型在原始形式的事实问题上回答正确，但在语义等价的释义下却生成了错误的答案。这种不一致性暴露了模型在语义不变性下潜在的事实不稳定性。然而，通用释义往往不足以作为面向鲁棒性的监督信号：近似复制的释义提供的信号较弱，而过度多样化的释义则可能破坏语义等价性。在本文中，我们提出了HALLUCINATION-R1，一个面向鲁棒性的释义生成框架，它学习生成语义忠实且具有鲁棒性挑战性的释义，以用于事实一致性评估。通过两阶段优化，该框架首先稳定保持语义且多样化的释义生成，随后奖励那些能在下游任务中揭示事实一致性退化的释义。
tldr: 该论文提出HALLUCINATION-R1框架，通过两阶段优化生成语义忠实但具鲁棒性挑战的释义，用以揭示大模型在语义等价改写下潜在的事实一致性退化问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes HALLUCINATION-R1, a two-stage optimized paraphrase generation framework that produces semantically faithful yet robustness-challenging paraphrases to expose latent factual consistency degradation in LLMs under semantic invariance.
